source.title: Minke whale pulse trains
source.author: NOAA Fisheries, Northeast Fisheries Science Center, Passive Acoustics Branch
source.notes: 8 kHz mono MP3, 39 s: one pulse train at 78-188 Hz, 26 dB over the background, building from soft short pulses (2-8 s) to a steady fast run, the pulses lengthening to its end at 37 s. Four stretches following it. Played rarely (weight 3 in biomes.json, to the other whales' 10).
